<STBG 0,0><BGM 0,0,503><TALK 1><NAME 1><CHAR 1,1,1,0,3><CV 1,1>We've arrived.
This is the first Volhier island,
Tripuu Island!

Volhier Archipelago has a shrine maiden,
and she manages the islands, apparently.

Because of that management,
landing permission is hard to come by.

For that reason too,
this island is still completely unexplored!

<CV 1,6><CHAR 1,0,1,2,4>There should be many discoveries!
Let's find them together!
